# The CycleVault

> The CycleVault is a calm, privacy-first menstrual cycle tracking app for Apple platforms. It runs fully on-device, requires no account, and frames tracking as a quiet personal practice rather than a feed of notifications.

The CycleVault is now available on the App Store. The marketing site at thecyclevault.com explains the product philosophy, feature set, privacy posture, and pricing intent, and hosts a small library of educational articles about menstrual cycles, hormones, and related topics.

Key product principles:
- No account required — all data stays on the user's device
- No advertising, no third-party trackers, no data brokers
- Calm, low-pressure UX — no streaks, gamification, or push-notification spam
- Designed for iOS, iPadOS, watchOS, and macOS
